scope: Deterministic implementation control only, reproducible with coverage_control.py and retained in COVERAGE_CONTROL.json. It is not a natural-frequency measurement, partner-selection evidence, or an end-to-end ECDLP claim, and it has no independent proof kind.
statement: On the retained deterministic nine-point overlap control, 6,756 of 25,694 distinct fixed-coordinate vectors occur in all nine origins, 12,220 are exclusive to one origin, and the pencil adds 3,066 invertible-target vectors over 16,492 at baseline while origin-local modular candidates increase from 21,322 to 99,622.
